verified_apis.scope: Browser-bundled Web Audio decoding; the resulting AudioBuffer reports sample rate, channels, sample count, and PCM signs.

no_api_findings.finding: The versioned core-module index lists no WAV-specific reader or decoder. Buffer, fs, and streams offer generic bytes/I/O and do not meet parser eligibility. This finding is limited to the documented Node.js core API index.

limit: Other browsers and JavaScript runtimes have not been control-checked.
